name: Taggia (Italy)
description: Yellow field with a red Greek cross throughout, the quarters charged with the red letters T, A, Y and A, with a yellow letter b at the centre and a red cross in the hoist and fly arms.
history: Municipal flag of Taggia, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Prime Minister on 12 June 1956.

features.role: letters T, A, Y, A in the quarters and small crosses on the arms
letter b at the centre of the cross
